translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Yesus dew fakusiw umi sung uta ko.
Kale aka Got gánlawin banimane, Yesus so alam weng kidimin kinim so ika Kiddán wok lung fako yak madik uniw. Kale yak madik be as Auliw tem kale aso alam weng kidimin kinim so iyo yak kal uniw ko.
Kale kamane Yesus gi wasi dauyamsa kinim Yuddas, aka im yak bakan uniw be alam kal. Kale be watawo kaleyo bá, Yesus ayo sun kuw alam weng kidimin kinim so kal une bidiw kal keisa kayo ko.

Kale Udom gawman im un tabudin kinim seng so Yol am bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim so Fedasi so imi un tabudin kinim keidiw iyo imadáliw yakom so lám so un so kudewiwe, Yuddas ata dolok mo imadewa as Auliw tem tasiw.
Kale Yesus ayo alam adikum kanodawokabiw bo alam kal, kale aka yak nadane dákadáyam, “kan finang tadiwe?” Yakeisa.
Ika fakadu bakodaw, “Yesus, Nasadet kayak am finang taduwo.” Akiwe, Yesus bakoyam, “naka nalata ka.” Yakeisa uyo Yuddas Yesus wasi gi dawkáyamin kinim ayo alaso, todba.
Kale Yesus ayo bako, “nalata ka” Kale kei badane, ika banbin keiyama ibik asin kau fakela dák bakan abesiw ko.
Asiki alo aka dákadáyam, “kiba, kan finang tadiwe?” Yakane, ika bakodaw, “Yesus Nasadet kayak finango.” Akiwe,
Yesus ayo fakadu bakoyam, “naka bakoyam, nalatano yakbi ka.” Yakei nadane bakoyam, “kiba nam fen tadbiw namti, nam nikil, ika imadáliw unin kala.”
Beta kanodiwo alam weng bakosa uyo matam dam keisu uyo bako, “naka kalam kinim walunamsaw iyo mak kutinongin banim.” Kalesa uta ko.
Kale bokal kayak ami wok fakudin kinim mak ami win Malkas am kilung kál iwkuk uyo Saimon Bita tabe woksek mak fakuba tuw, takadu kudálawane,
Yesus ayo Bita weng kitid kuw bakodaw, “kaba woksek uyo kudew yak ulum bán kutiyo, kaba nam Natim kál funin kano kudulalo nakba uyo kuduloma báyo. Nakbáwe?” Akeisa ko.
Yesus dew Anas finang unsiw umi sung uta ko.
Udom gawman un tabudin kinim gu keidiwe, ilim kamok yak kanodin maek kanodin yakin kinim keidane, Yu kayak un tabudin keidiw iyo Yesus sakaw dew faku sok gei dau nadiwade
kamakikiw dew tad Anas dádawsiw. Kale Anas aka Kayafas ami adol, kale aka bemi itol kal bokal kayak kei be.
Kayo Kayafas alata kamakikiw Yu kayak bakoyam, “ken kinim makuw ata kinim imi as bo fikalak.” Kalesa ata ko.
Bita kamakikiw iwálusa umi sung uta ko.

Saimon Bita keida, Yesus alam weng kidimin kinim mak keida, ika Yesus dewiw iliso ibik tein kin mo unsiw. Kale alam weng kidimin kinim mak aka Yesus dewiw alaso uniw ki, yak bokal kayak am abiw dám tem uniw.

Bita ata dám awsom abiwo kaw tam kal toda keibisiw, be watawo kaleyo bá, bokal kayak ayo weng kidimin kinim mak be alam kal kayo, kale weng kidimin kinim mak ayo asiki maek dám awsom kin moyámin wanang bakomam nadale Bita ayo dabadála tam dám tem unsa ko.
Kale dám awsom kin moyámin wanang uyo Bita dákadálaw, “afan kaba mew kinim belami weng kidimin kinim bade bá?” Akune, aka fakadu bakomam, “naka bá.” Kalesa.
Kale gid tabe badano kayo, wok fakudin kinim so un tabudin kinim so iyo as daudiw kain bada falal bom as tudu bom keimiwe, Bita akal iso yak tod bom as tudu bom keimsa ko.
Bokal kayak Yesus dákadálawsa umi sung uta ko.
Kana bidiwe Bokal kayak ayo Yesus alam weng kidimin kinim imi sung so alam kukuyamin umi sung so uyo dákadálawsa.
Kale Yesus ayo fakadu bakodaw, “naka bakan kayak misun weng bakayamusi. Naka kawed am so Yol am so kal Yu kayak iyo tada tada keibidiw, sun kuw kukuyamábi, kata naka iwál weng mak bakoyamongin danim.
Kale watawo dákadánabáwe? Kidi bidiw bakamsi, ita dákadálo? Atin afan ika nalam weng bakamin bo ilim kal, kale ita bakokamino.”
Kale bako kei badane, un tabudin kinim mak mew todba, ata tabe kulfom dew yak kibi binodaw nadane bakodaw, “bokal kayak be kanodin weng bakadawine?” Akane,
Yesus fakadu bakodaw, “kata naka weng mafak mak bakabi, kayo kana bakodalo! Kata naka afin weng bakabi uyo watawo kale nambidáwe?” Akeisa.
Kale Anas ayo dabadála yak Kayafas bokal kayak atamsa. Kata Yesus ayo sok bádawongin banim ko.
Bita Yesus weng alew mo iwálusa umi sung uta ko.
Kale Saimon Bita aka as tudu bom tod alane, ika dákadálalaw, “afan kaba ami weng kidimin kinim memak? Akiwe, aka iwálu nadane, “naka bá.” Kalesa ko.
Bita alam bokal kayak wok fakudawin kinim woksek kudu kilung kal takadu kudák teidaba, kinim ami duw mak ayo dákadálaw, kawta un bi yak Auliw tem kal alaso katabine?” Akane,
asiki Bita ayo iwál badane, kawákal kokoduk gán dása ko.
Yesus Bailet dim kot keimsa umi sung uta ko.

Kale Yu kayak ika Yesus Kayafas am dim kalo dew yak Udom tabalasew ami am dukum unsiw uyo kutim kama am gakgak fadena tadbu. Kale Yu kayak ika tam gawman am unongin danim, be watawo kaleyo bá, im aket masi tam am naduw amkim so kei naduwe tam Akayam Unemin ban imin asino faleloluwo, kale nadiwo ko.
Kale Bailet aka matam abiw nadanade dákadáyam, “watawnak ban keidano, kinim bela dew tadiw.” Yaka nade
ika fakadu bakodaw, “aka ban keimin keidoma bá nam, watawo kale dew tad dákamoduw bá.” Akiwe,

Bailet ayo bakoyam, “kibal dew yak nadiwo kibilim sawa abem bakosu kuw abo nadiwo, taktaka daudino.” Yakane, Yu kayak iyo Bailet bakodaw, “nuka ban keimin kinim ankabimin bewok be num weng mit bá.” Kalesiw.
Kale bemi kanodawsiw be Yesus alam weng bako kanodin fikalanámin uyo kanodokabino, kalesa uyo matam dam keiduko kaleyo ko.
Bailet aka alo asiki tam am dukum nadanade Yesus gán dádawa, tam una dákadálaw, “kaba Yu kayak im kamokime?” Akane,
Yesus asik yán ki bakodaw, “kaba kanodin weng dákadánabaw bo kalam aket tei dákadálaw bade kinim kukum ita nam sung bo bakokamsiwe?” Akane,
Bailet fakadu bakodaw, “kam aket naka Yu kayake? Bá! Kalam kinim so bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim so ilita kamadew tad dánamiw. Kale kaba yaknámin ban uta keibaw?” Akane,

Yesus bako, “nam kasák gu be bakan dim kadákale, nalam kasák gu uyo kadákal nam, nalam wok fakudin kinim iyo nam guew dudu namadáliw yak Yu kayak sikal ban dim abomino kale gelei ginanongin, kata nam kasák gu be ukul kalo anang mak bu kayo ko.” Akeisa.

Kale Bailet bakodaw nadale, “kaba Kamokim namti, kawtane?” Akane, Yesus fakadu bakodaw, “kaba Kamokim nakaw uyo dam weng afan bakodaw. Kale naka buta kanodono, kale tad bakan kadák namusu. Kale beta kanodino afan weng bakamin uyo matam misunuko kale tasi, kale kan kinim ata afan weng bakamin umino keibe namti, aka nam weng kidinamába.” Akane,
Bailet dákadálaw, “wataw weng uta afane?” Kalbane, beta Bailet ayo asiki tam abiw kal nadale, Yu kayak bakoyam, “naka am ban keimin mak utam nadino masi, sok gei daudokabi bá.

Kale bo kibilim kukuw kanamin uyo itol makuw makuw uyo Akayam Unemin ban imin wanin atan kawákal sok gei tabesiw kinim makuw talá dabadáli yak kilim teng dim abe abeyábiw. Kale kim aket Yu kayak imi kamokim ata min talá dabadáli yak kilim teng dim abake?” Kalane,
ika weng ngadák faku dau bakodaw, “ata bá, num aket Badábas ata.” Kalesiw. Kale Badábas be gawman ilik ilokya bom yakot wan bom nadane ginin kinim ata ko.
